title: Maharashtra Govt Seeking To Shield 'Big Mandals' Through PoP Idols Immersion Policy: PIL Petitioner Tells Bombay High Court
description: The Bombay High Court was on Friday (July 17) told that the Maharashtra Government was trying to protect 'big mandals' by pressing for allowing immersion of Ganesh idols made of Plaster of Paris (PoP) above the height of six feet, in natural water bodies.� A division bench of Justice Ajay Gadkari and Justice Kamal Khata has been hearing final arguments in the Public Interest Litigation (PIL) filed by activist Rohit Joshi, who has sought a total ban on immersion of PoP idols in natural bodies, ir
